title: Gaddi quuka
intro: Atu mango gadda le aydaaduk foocal solta, dahab kee caylat bilqite mano, takkay immay ellecaboh baadal tan giclo faxa marah inkih cubbi baritto. atu ta muucih kinnaane fakkiissam duuddaa kay aydaadi waktit qagaaqagitak, baadal tan duyyeeya elle taturtah tan ginoh sumaq?
clues: Anu kaxxa nabiyyih ummattak suge, takkay immay anu kaxxiinaa kee zulmi gita doorite.
Yalli mango gadda yoh yeceeh, yi gaddih maftacitte maqar le marih buttah kaxxa quukak sugte.
Yi ummatta yoo fayiseh yi gaddat ruffa edde axce waam, Yalli ruffa iyyam makicnam yoo kassiisak.
Anu kaxxiinitak excem yi fidin gadda inni ixxigaa kee macal kinnim, Yallih barkat hinna.
Yoh umaadobi diggah yoh abeh sugem kee Yalli yoh yeceemit akeera gorrisam kassiisih sugem takkay immay anu aabbem cineeh inni kaxxiinit bisoh axce.
Elle caboh Yalli ardi yoo kee yi sigmah yanxuqeh, kay amritteh saduh uli cato sinnim yoo cabe.
verse: So We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no body of supporters to aid him other than Allah, nor was he of those who could defend themselves. (Al-Qasas 28:81)
arabic: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِ وَبِدَارِهِ الْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُ مِن فِئَةٍ يَنصُرُونَهُ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُنتَصِرِينَ
